test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a certain work in 6 hours, and A, B and C together take 4 hours to do the same. How long will it take for C alone to accomplish the task?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a certain work in 6 hours

A, B and C together take 4 hours to do the same.

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency of the workers ×&nbs
